items.title: Jerry Hey interviewed by Monk Rowe, via Zoom, November 2, 2023
items.q: they’re doing a movie that Pharrell has some songs in that we’re going to play some horns on maybe next week.

ctx.x: Nice. Happy to hear that. I’ll just wrap up with a question about what’s coming up for you?

I have a few things here and there, not a lot, and I’m okay with that. But you know I’ll do kind of a project sort of, a month, and guys will call me up — we just finished a project from a guy from Germany who flew over to do the horns on three tunes. And we have a movie coming up that my son works for Harvey Mason Jr. if you know of Harvey Mason Sr., the drummer, his son is a big time producer and working on movies mostly now. My son works for him as his engineer and they’re doing a movie that Pharrell has some…

Is it tough for you over the years to, you want to send in the Jerry Hey Horns so does that mean that you have to get on the phone with all the members every time you get called for a recording session? To see that they could all make it?
